_description: Training configuration for GPR (Gaussian Process Regression) with POD (Proper Orthogonal Decomposition)

normalization._comment: Scaling/normalization strategy for inputs (P) and outputs (X). Options: 'none', 'std', 'range', etc.

POD._comment: Mode selection strategy for dimensionality reduction. Options: 'variance' (energy-based), 'number' (manual count)
